One company scenario, explicit relationships

From a pump condition to a classified cost.

  1. ObserveTwo qualifying episodes become one condition case. Unknown readings stay unknown.
  2. ReviewMaintenance reviews the evidence and releases the case to an approved repair work package.
  3. TransactThe item/work-purpose policy supplies account and cost center. Purchasing approval remains separate.
  4. ExplainThe exact request links the resulting PO, invoice and payment allocations to the business report.

A normal reading or paid invoice does not establish completed maintenance. All company observations, approvals and outcomes are fictional. The software decisions and calculations work.

Architecture, technology and data integrity

The interfaces use HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Pure rule modules handle coding, monetary allocations, invoice matching, command replay and analytical projections. Browser views present the same journal instead of keeping separate copies of each workflow's financial results.

Machine observations are deterministic fictional fixtures with unit, quality, UTC time and asset identity. Curation retains a reasoned exclusion ledger. State intervals partition the replay window. A reviewed maintenance case links to purchasing through a stable request ID; the BI model uses declared fact grains and integer cents.

Native links, responsive layouts, keyboard controls and progressive disclosures make the experience inspectable. Automated rule and browser checks run in CI. The browser report is not embedded Power BI, and this portfolio does not need live employer systems, credentials or paid connectors.

What is implemented, and where the demonstration stops

Implemented: governed requisitions, simulated purchasing approval/PO, receipt checks, single/multi-line invoices, connected CSV batch staging, owned exceptions, reviewed supplier corrections, posting, separate authorization/settlement, browser BI, machine replay, maintenance review, idempotent purchasing handoff, recorded work and independent completion verification.

Outside these scenarios: live equipment control, authenticated production roles, PDF/email OCR, general-ledger completeness, tax/credits/FX, native Power BI authoring and automatic proof of maintenance completion. These boundaries do not prevent the complete simulated journeys described above.
